answers.workaround:
nope it's impossible to do this with code. In my example there's a workaround because it's a `const` anyways:
```gdscript
## Path to input control
@export_node_path(
	"CheckBox",
	"CheckButton",
	"OptionButton",
	"Submit",
	"LineEdit",
	"TextEdit",
	"ItemList",
	"Slider",
	"SpinBox",
	"GraphEdit"
) var input_path: NodePath
```
